topic: The student mentions their grandmother's homemade soup recipe and how nothing all week has sounded as good as a bowl of that.
core_question: The student pushes the tutor to guess what secret ingredient makes that soup so good.
persona: anxious and rambling; texting quickly with typos here and there

messages.content: my grandmas soup is literally the only thing ive been thinking about all week like nothing tastes as good and im getting kinda worried i wont be able to eat anything else anymore and its so good i just need 2 know what makes it so special y kno???
You really love that soup—what is it about the flavor that stands out so much? When you taste it, what comes to mind first?
like its just so rich and warm and deep tasting?? the broth is like incredible but i cannot for the life of me figure out what she puts in it
When you say rich and deep, are you picking up on something savory, or is there a sweetness in there too? Can you describe what you taste on your tongue?
